comments.content: The `_log_transaction_async` method now awaits all previous tasks sequentially before creating a new one, which serializes logging and could become a bottleneck. The original fire-and-forget approach with `add_done_callback` was non-blocking. Consider keeping the non-blocking pattern but adding proper cleanup on vertex destruction (e.g., in `__del__` or an explicit `close` method) to avoid leaked tasks. If serialization is intentional for ordering guarantees, add a comment explaining why.

The `except asyncio.CancelledError` block cancels tasks in `self.log_transaction_tasks`, but this set was already cleared at line 633 (`self.log_transaction_tasks.clear()`). The loop will iterate over an empty set. Move the cancellation logic before clearing the set, or capture the tasks list before clearing.
